Employee permissions, attendance, and shifts
Advanced POS: split bills, refunds, taxes, tips, transfers, receipts

Notifications and audit logs
Subscription billing, plans, trials, renewals, and limits
Real payment gateway, email, SMS, and third-party integrations
The current project already covers authentication, menu/table management, QR ordering, online checkout, kitchen/bar/counter workflows, inventory, reports, promotions, discounts, superadmin basics, realtime updates, and the recent dashboard/sold-out work.
